summary: Moggill Road median-side lane with no stopping and clearway; nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Clearway tow-away and no stopping signs
Line sits on a median, not a kerb

drivers.seclusion: Homes 23-45 m across the road; retail and car park to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Line runs along a painted median between carriageways; no room to stop out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic in both directions.
drivers.convention: No parked cars; No Stopping Any Time and Mon-Sat clearway with tow away.
